label: TP
reason: User input via getParameterNames flows directly to bar in doSomething without any filtering or validation. The guard condition (500/42)+num>200 is always true, ensuring param reaches bar. Bar is then concatenated into SQL string which is executed via JDBC template, creating an SQL injection vulnerability. While ESAPI encoder is used later, the SQL execution happens before encoding and the concatenation creates unescaped input in the query string.

evidence.note: User input flows through doSomething to bar and is concatenated into SQL string before execution
